name: Lagos Colony and Protectorate
definition: Rounded population of the combined Colony and Protectorate used to calculate taxation per head. The source gives no reference day. This is an alternative to the 1901 table's mixed total of 1,388,847 and the superintendent's 1,250,000 estimate.

name: Lagos Colony and Protectorate
locator: Printed p. 5, Summary Table 2, note (b); p. 145, section 18, table 1, footnote.
method: census superintendent's rounded alternative to a mixed count and estimate
definition: The superintendent's whole-jurisdiction estimate allowing for likely overstatement in the district estimates. The full table separately reports 1,388,847, of whom 41,847 were enumerated. The source gives no uncertainty bound.

name: Lagos Colony and Protectorate
definition: Rounded population of the Lagos territory, used to express five years of liquor imports per person. The reference day and estimation method are unspecified. The difference from the 1901 mixed total compares source estimates.
